text: Charged for ranch dressing to dip fries. Never refilled water.

Acrually quite delicious. Those collards greens are gud. I had that crazy everything burger with crispt chicken skins AND pimento cheese AND green tomato and: yum. Its a big burger. Im a small portions person so it made two meals for me, especially with the side of yummy fries. My botfriend got the ribs and he loved them. With it, he got the mac and cheese and mashed potatoes with chicken gravy because hes just extra fancy like that and yum to it all. The mashed potatoes needed maybe a touch more sour cream or something to moisten them but still damn good.

I got the marshmellow old fashioned and it is the most drinkable old fashioned ive ever had.

Plus. Sorghum butter. Wtf. Keep doing that.

**update** the campfire of is just clever. Cozy. Its the best drink in charlottesville. When I want to grab a drink out it is this one. The bartenders are machines. Not a big fan of super crowded bars and this one is bc its just great, but its worth it to me to enjoy this amazing cocktail!
Love the drinks and the live music!
Just stopped in for a pre dinner bourbon. The servers know their stuff and are very friendly and educational about what they are serving! Thank you!
Great Food. Great Service!!!
Nice chill place 😊

Great place with decent prices. Plenty of options for food, desserts, and drinks. While there are many whiskey options, there's a wide variety of beers too. Danielle was very helpful and patient with us trying to decide between all the great choices. Cozy atmosphere and not too loud for conversations. Do not underestimate the fried chicken sandwich dipping in a side of the honey jalapeño sauce - oh my goodness, excellent!!
Just had a beer.  Live music outside
Wonderful experience with a live Irish band while enjoying their Octoberfest menu. Bar tender and chef were both top tier.

The atmosphere here is great, the location is prime, and the beer was ice-cold. Unfortunately, the rest of the experience missed the mark. Service was lacking, and the food was disappointing—my catfish po'boy was served cold and had very little flavor. There’s so much potential here with the great vibe, but the kitchen and service needs some attention.

What a great place.
Food was v good but the best thing about the place is the amazing band they have playing outside.
Had an absolutely lovely evening
The peach cobbler was out of this world! It was so good!

Came from DC to Charlottesville on a work trip and had lunch at the Whiskey Jar with my co-worker. This place is a whiskey connoisseur’s happy place. They have an amazing selection of whiskeys. The fried chicken sandwich is probably the best damn chicken sandwich I’ve had, but wait… After a few bites, I poured on some of the jalapeño garlic honey. Maaaan, it took it up a few more notches!

Now back to the whiskey… They have some private barrel bourbons that you can only get at the Whiskey Pot, so my buddy and I both had a glass of Elijah Craig Barrel Proof 9 yr (Whiskey Jar Private Barrel 2022 -“Caramel”). Amazing. The service at the bar was excellent. I highly recommend this spot if you’re in Charlottesville. 💯 STAMP!

Got recommendations for this place from the rental car desk and the hotel desk.  Farm to table restaurant. Nice atmosphere. Large whiskey and draft beer selections.  Service was slow beginning when we first walked in the door to ask for a table.  It was slow the entire time.  The bill was incorrect with an extra drink, but they fixed it.  The blackened catfish sandwich was bad.  The fish tasted muddy. My wife had the French dip, and it was good, but nothing special.  There was live music, but the lead singer was not great.

Service was great! They were super flexible and accommodating with our rowdy group, especially since we arrived late at night. I also wanted to mention that I was looking at a copy of the receipt afterward and realized I had miscalculated the tip. They were incredibly kind and honored the total amount I intended to pay. The final total was $10 more than what I had written on the tip line, but they still charged me the correct amount. I really appreciated their understanding and kindness. Thanks so much!

We had an amazing lunch/dinner at The Whiskey Jar! 🍽️ Everything was excellent—from the delicious food and great drinks to the wonderful staff. Totally loved the corn bread!!The service was friendly and welcoming, and we truly enjoyed our entire experience. Highly recommend The Whiskey Jar if you’re in Charlottesville!
Servers were great. Nice vibe

​On Saturday night, I was denied entry by the taller of two bouncers because of my service animal. After he stated, "I'm not letting you in with that dog," I calmly explained that I have a disability, that he is my service animal, and that we cannot legally be denied entry. He replied, "I'm just gonna say that you drank too much and got belligerent." Denying entry under these circumstances, and threatening to fabricate a reason to bypass accessibility laws, is illegal.

​Under Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act (28 CFR § 36.302(c)), places of public accommodation (including bars and nightclubs) must permit service animals in all areas open to patrons. Fabricating, or threatning to fabricate, allegations of intoxication to bypass accessibility requirements—is a direct violation of federal law.
Clam chowder was thick like gravy. Salmon was really good!  I was looking fwd to my soup, so this was a disappointment. Atmosphere & service were excellent.

Honestly… I was having a decent night until I was asked to leave for no apparent reason. I ordered drinks for the father of the bride, and was told that I was assertive in how I ordered the drinks.

I didn’t disturb any patrons in my vicinity. It was absurd. We are here tomorrow as well, and none of us will be returning.
Great service and kindness.
We drive from NJ to this spot on our way down to Myrtle Beach. Fried chicken & collards are phenomenal. Corn bread has a butter on it thats worth the IG photo. Old fashions are on point!

We hosted the afterparty for our wedding at Whiskey Jar and it was the most perfect venue! All of our guests had the best time with the live music inside the bar and the outdoor patio perfect for chatting and catching up with friends! Christy and the entire bar team were so great to work with and it was so easy to set up a bar tab for our guests. The bartenders were attentive and the band gave myself and my groom a shoutout during their set, and it was just the best touch to finish out such an awesome day!
A good place to eat. Will be back there soon

Excellent food and service, had Riley, who was incredible and helpful.  Enjoyed the pulled pork nachos, Riley said the brownie & ice cream was the best on the east coast, she was right, highly recommend, will be back

We went to dinner here last night and had a wonderful time! We've lived in Charlottesville for about two years now and have always heard of whiskey jar, however we never visited. I did not realize how incredible the food would be! We had the wings with a peach chipotle sauce as well as BBQ mac and cheese. Our entree was the shrimp and grits. For dessert we got the peach cobbler and bread pudding. Every course was delicious and I can't wait to come back to have some more of their wings. Our server was Thomas and he was wonderful. He was great with recommendations, gave very fast service, and anticipated what we might need before even asking. I could not have asked for a nicer time for the start of restaurant week. Thank you whiskey jar and thank you Thomas!

Mojitos were perfect! Bourbon flights were perfect for my husband. Food was good. Service was good. Sat outside with dog(one of four tables).-accurate on Bring Fido. Easily walkable from Home2Suites hotel. Free outdoor concert downtown too. Only negatives were it seemed as if many stores on Downtown Mall were closed by 5:30pm on a Friday ???????  AND occasional homeless person-scattered through city.  -Also, , a bench near restaurant definitely had some heavy pot smokers lingering-a police presence would’ve been better.

Came in with a couple of friends on a Saturday evening and we were seated right away. The ambiance is lively with things on the wall to keep my eyes wandering. Our server was nice and attentive. The reason for the 3 stars is the food, it's average. I'll speak to the plates I tried, which were the Po Boy and the Red Snapper plate. Neither of those dishes stood out, where I could taste delight while eating them. I didn't feel they were made with love, moreso this is what it is. Another friend ordered the rib platter, which the meal was big in size, they could finish it.

Enjoyed a fantastic time in The Whiskey Jar, the bar staff were great fun and really knowledgeable about the Whiskies available and the Smoked Strawberry Lavender Old Fashioned cocktail using Old Forester Bourbon was delicious and only $14.
Enjoyed a bowl of homemade chicken and dumping soup and the Beef Jar Dip was really lovely.
The live music from the band in the evening was great fun too, real toe tapping stuff and plenty of folk were dancing. A really great atmosphere.

Delicious and high quality take on southern style food. Extensive drink selection and the monthly specials are wonderful. You can sit outside and people watch or sit inside and marvel at the eclectic decor including Bob the Boar. Friendly and hard working staff who never push you to finish fast and get out. Did I mention the delicious food? Highly recommend the enormous veggie burger. The fries are perfection and the mashed potatoes are divine. The grits have a little kick to them and the fried chicken biscuit was so big you could hardly fit it in your mouth. Don’t miss the cobbler. It’s big enough to share, comes warmed, and has a generous helping of ice cream on top. Anyone can find something they like at this place. Nightly live music is a major bonus and we really enjoyed the Wednesday night regular band.

What a great experience at The Whiskey Bar restaurant, food was amazing drinks for even better. The old Fashions were the best.
Deja was a great server!
Not to mention the dessert!! Peach cobbler
Nice local hangout with music.
Exceptional experience from start to finish. Everyone was super friendly and welcoming, and entire party felt the food and drinks were phenomenal. 100% recommend.

Amazing experience from a very unassuming spot. Food was fantastic, great beer/whiskey/bourbon selection. If nothing else, go for the brown liquor choices. Most comprehensive selection I have ever seen. The quality of the food will shock you if you are a first-time visitor.
So happy I stopped in, the French dip was killer & Will was wonderful/ super helpful!

Chris, Christina, and Jasmine are all incredible!!! They put me on to new drinks and were super friendly with their service. I recommend everyone bring their friend and have a good drink, this place rocks!
Charlottesville was a stop over for us on a drive home.  We didn't know where to go to eat and my son found this place.  It had options for all of us and we loved our food here.

I’ve been to the walking mall twice now and both times I’ve started the evening walking to the Whiskey Jar and ended the night there. Jasmine is phenomenal and besides the food and drinks she recommends, she why we keep going back!
Always have an amazing time! Jasmine is extremely welcoming, knowledgeable, and makes the trip worth it each time. Will come back time and time again!

I am from Boston and only staying here through Monday but I had the most amazing experience at The Whiskey Jar! Wide selection of whiskey and bourbon, and the food was delicious! All of the staff was super attentive despite being very busy with the 50th anniversary of the Downtown Mall. I hope to make it back at least once more before I fly home. Jasmine was very informative about other things to do around the area and very nice. All of the staff was top notch! Thank you for a very pleasant experience as a first timer in Charlottesville!
Bar was great. Will be back to try the food!

Had a great pre show meal!!

Will was a great server, very attentive, and knowledgeable! Wonderful atmosphere and great drinks!
Absolutely the best spot in Charlottesville, hands down. Fabulous food, wonderful whiskey, stupendous service, and marvelous music. Don’t miss this genuine gem!

Food was terrible   Pork chops were terrible.- taste like cooked in bacon grease. Broccoli salad wth lots of cheese and cranberries with no dressing. No season to chicken and dumpling soup-tasted like  old chicken.  We inquired about what tupe of vhickrn in chicken sandwich and the waiter said not white meat or dark meat. What isit???

Horrible experience. Drove into town with my disabled father who was hungry. Place an online order which was lost. Waited forever. They forgot two out of fore entrées. Parking is atrocious. Zero out of 10 do not recommend ever.
Burger Great. Pulled pork good. Ribs burnt and dry. Catfish good. Service excellent.

The staff here were amazingly kind! I came in with two kids and they were wonderful with getting their food out quickly and being very understanding. My food was also delicious and I will definitely be back
Cool place.
An open air restaurant and bar in Charlottesville.   I had the trout, which was excellent,  but be aware it's served whole.  The cocktails seem well tended as well.
Really good food, great service.  Normal prices for Downtown Mall.  Will return to sample additional items.
It's on the downtown mall.  Inside and outside seating.  Music and dancing.  Fun!
Really good value for $
food was excellent the wings with the peach was awesome. and the fried green beans were interesting different in a good way. Definitely will be back

Kris the bartender was a phenomenal host. Super welcoming, kind and knowledgeable about the expansive whiskey program. Saturday afternoon had an amazing irish jam going on with accordion/fiddle/mandolin/amazing. Top 20 all time.
Everything we tried was amazing! So many yummy flavors. I loved the shrimp and grits…so much flavor in every bite!

When we're in the mood for whiskey, we come here. Lots of variety and great specials on Virginia made whiskey. Good place to sit down at the bar or outside when the weather is nice and have a couple drinks.
Drinks were great. Food was delicious. Vibe was on point. I think they only had 2 servers for the whole place and it was packed so service was rather slow but it worked out.

We stumbled upon this adorable restaurant as we strolled through the downtown mall and it exceeded our expectations! You feel welcome as soon as you walk through the door with the friendly staff and decorative lighting. They had live music playing which made our experience even more enjoyable. We started off with an appetizer of fried green beans that was AMAZING! My husband and I both ordered burgers which were very good and made us so full. We did leave some room for dessert which fulfilled every craving that we had! If we find ourselves in Charlottesville again, we will be back to this place!

The last few times I've visited the Whiskey Jar have been wonderful. But they have been more late night. There was great live music, and a very good selection of whiskey to choose from, if you're so inclined for something more top shelf. Service is always prompt at the bar even on busy nights.

Food was excellent but we had a pretty lackluster experience with the service. We went around 5pm and it took forever for food and service. I watched the waitress serve and check on several other tables more than once before she came back to ours. Again, food was amazing but not sure it was worth being there over an hour before we get food and our check during a time where they only had a handful of tables.
We loved this place. Simple small menu for food but endless drinks.

I must've been there on an off night, based on everyone else's reviews. We were sat quickly, but then immediately ignored for at least 15 minutes before greeted by the waitstaff. Then we waited quite a while again before our orders were taken (this whole time no water was brought to the table). For entertainment, we watched the waitstaff of the restaurant during this time. There was little to no visible organization to approach, with staff going hither and yon with little to no results in serving the patrons of the restaurant. Whatever was going on in the "staff only" room in the back must've been amazing, because the staff spent as much time in there as they did on the floor of the restaurant. Multiple guests from other tables had to directly approach staff members to get their food, drinks, and/or checks.

If it wasn't for the youngest member on staff busting his backside to run food from the kitchen, seat guests, bus tables, and wrap silverware... I'm fairly certain nothing would've been accomplished in the operation of the front of house of the restaurant.

I can't really blame the staff only, it was fairly obvious there was a breakdown in basic operating systems that should have been implemented in the restaurant, but obviously were not. That falls on management and training, plain and simple.

Faith and begorra, what a find! If ye be lookin’ for a pot o’ gold at the end of the rainbow, ye’ve found it right here at the Whiskey Jar.
Our clan stopped in for a feast, and let me tell ye, the spread was enough to make any sprite skip with joy. We filled our bellies with the pork and Mac and cheese, a basket o' fries crisp enough to rattle a pooka, and plates of biscuits, hush puppies, and kid chicken fingers that vanished faster than a disappearing glen. And the bread pudding? 'Twas a sweet treasure indeed!
But the real magic wasn't just in the kitchen. The service and the vibe were the true enchantments. Every soul workin' there was as kind and helpful as a friendly brownie, makin' us feel right at home. To top off the evening, we had live music by the bard that had us tap-tapping our heels to the rhythm.
Five stars for a legendary night! I’d trade me last gold coin for another visit.

Stop by for a couple drinks and apps

First, I ordered an Irish drop shot, they actually knew what it was. Along with an old fashioned.

Both drinks were made perfectly. And served as they should be.

I ordered the collards, cornbread, and grits. The collards were perfect and need nothing. Same with the grits. The only downside of my visit was the cornbread. Stand alone. The cornbread is great. But it does not need the caramel that they put on top of it.

Wait staff was amazing. And honestly, other than the caramel and the cornbread there is no complaint whatsoever
Great place to hang with co workers

Had a good and fast dinner here. I had the chicken and dumpling soup, while my husband enjoyed the burger. We split the (amazingly huge) bread pudding for dessert, which was a bit disappointing, and cold in the middle.

Fantastic food, attentive service.

It's four, not five stars because I was a little disappointed that the server didn't inform us he had auto'd our party. There were six of us on a single check, so the sever was within his rights to auto, but when you do that, you have a responsibility to inform the customer.

Food was extraordinary, though. Excellent shrimp and grits, perfectly cooked catfish, tasty gumbo. Whiskey sour was also on point, perfect balance of sour and whiskey. Beer selection is okay, cocktails are better.

My partner reached out to Chris and Christina at the Whiskey Jar to see if there was a way to make a proposal happen at our favorite bar in town, and they absolutely knocked it out of the park! Their kindness and joy at helping him execute was incredible, and they managed to make a beautiful private space feel like its own world, even on a busy weekend night. They even went so far as to help us clean up and hold our extra items overnight so we didn't have to worry about it. They also both got rave reviews from a good friend who made sure everything was set up in time. Whiskey Jar will forever be our favorite spot in town to stop in and celebrate!
Fun time!

I've lived in Charlottesville for nearly five years and have been to The Whiskey Jar a handful of times. It never disappoints. Excellent cocktail menu, always excellent service and good food. Whenever I have out-of-town guests, I make sure they get the local flavor and Whiskey Jar is always on the itinerary.

We went here for the live music. Special shout out to Matthew O'Donnell for the invigorating energy and amazing music. Spent hours in the place just for the music. Its mind blowing how many instruments he played! Its ljke a magician who gets out a different instrument every two minutes.

Unexpectedly, the food was also quite nice. The vegetarian burger might feel slightly dry, but less so than most other american burgers. The hummus and veggies were great and healthy. Although, I wonder from the huge size of the veggies whether they are gmo. The hummus tho has a brilliant taste!

Moreover, one of the most lively place in the downtown. Love it!
Overall great experience. Would highly recommend the smoked buffalo wings.
Very cool vibe! Plus it has fantastic BBQ, amazing whiskey and craft beer choices and great service. Will definitely go back!
We got the bbq nachos which were delicious and the fries and broccoli slaw were also really good. Oyster po boy was huge. Tried a few seasonal drinks all were very tasty. 10/10 no complaints
Bartenders were extremely attentive and knowledgeable. Drinks were delicious. No notes.
Cornbread to die for
I was just passing through and might never make it back, but I would sure like to. Funky atmosphere, great food, and excellent drinks. I was with a large group and everyone just loved it.

I’ve been here before to go to the bar and enjoy live music, but didn’t realize they had an entire robust menu! On top of that, the food is excellent!

Got the beet salad and it was very good! Going to try the chicken sandwich next and will update if I do.

Dining at The Whiskey Jar was an experience that left a lasting impression. From the moment of arrival, the welcoming atmosphere set the tone for a wonderful meal. The staff provided excellent service, attentive without being intrusive, friendly, and eager to ensure everything was perfect. Their genuine hospitality made the visit feel relaxed and personal, which is rare in many restaurants today.

The real highlight, however, was the food. The menu showcased Southern-inspired flavors with a modern touch, and every bite delivered. The catfish sandwich stood out among the offerings it was perfectly cooked, lightly crisp on the outside, and tender within. The seasoning was on point, allowing the natural flavor of the catfish to shine through, complemented by fresh toppings and a soft, toasted bun. The side dishes were equally impressive, especially the fries, which were golden and perfectly salted.

The overall dining experience felt both comfortable and elevated a blend of casual charm and culinary quality. The Whiskey Jar is the kind of place that invites you to linger a little longer, savoring the balance of good service, excellent food, and genuine Southern warmth. It’s definitely a spot worth revisiting.

I absolutely love this place!! The bartenders were amazing. My wife and I were celebrating our 2 year anniversary and they gave us a complimentary first round! I had the smoked old fashioned and my wife had smoked apple mule and both were wonderful. My wife had the chicken sandwich with fries and it was so dam good lol I had the cheeseburger salad woth goat cheese ranch and it was simple but tasted wonderful. So many selections of burbon/whisky, scotch, and beer! The bathrooms were clean aswell as the restaurant. They have outside seating and there open late which it kinda turns into a little club vibe. I highly recommend to stop at this restaurant every time your at the downtown mall.
My wife and I loved this place. They make great drinks and it's a fun atmosphere. A lot going on! Bartenders are awesome as well.
Great college town restaurant! Good service!
Fun, busy, place,
This place was amazing. The food was delicious and the drink selection is unmatched!
Food was good ish service was stellar and bread pudding was amazing.

Had dinner here on a Saturday night while visiting Charlottesville and it was great. I sat at the bar and the bartenders were friendly and attentive. My appetizer was delayed but they comped a drink for me as a courtesy which I appreciated. The food was awesome.
First time there. Great food and service!

Saw some incredibly unprofessional behavior on the part of the Whiskey Jar staff on Friday night, October 24. The bouncer denied a young blonde woman entry, then held her ID over her head like a game of monkey in the middle. He then tossed the ID onto the downtown mall and very violently pushed the young lady into the street. Classless people who hit women. Won’t be coming back again.
Great selection of all kinds of whiskeys and tap beer, including many from Virginia. Live music often.
Cocktails and whiskey selection is always creative and unique! Bartenders were so kind and accommodating. Always have live music and great vibes.
Had lunch here today, my wife had the Ruben and I had the grilled catfish dinner entree, both were AMAZING!  Great flavor, plentiful.  They also have an impressive whiskey and liquor menu!

Fun spot that has a lot of good whisky; but you'll pay for it. Some of their rare whiskys are too expensive.

The food is great! I recommend the pork chop! It was cooked perfectly and was delicious. The atmosphere is awesome too. The live music is really fun!
Get there for happy hour 😎🤘
Excellent food, service, atmosphere, and bourbon selection.

I went there to experience a late night out with a family member and turned out to be a great idea as we enjoyed Blackberry margaritas and the sound of a live jazz band at this restaurant.  The waitress was very kind and did a great job making sure our glasses were full. The food was hot, I had smoked wings. The Wings were a bit dry however the sauce was a good compliment.  I look forward to coming and trying more food options.
Hamburger was good just not 5 starts good.  Band was playing,  service was good and atmosphere was friendly.
Really good crispy chicken sandwich. Quick and nice service.
Highly recommend Campfire Old Fashioned! The smell of scent from fire processing + marshmallow

We sat outside the shrimp and grits was excellent the burger was definitely rare but it was delicious service outside was a little on the slow end I kept on getting overlooked but where one failed another would come in and saw that I was needed attention great place great atmosphere
Food was delicious.  Live music.  Comfortable atmosphere of a classic bar.
If it's on the menu it's delicious
I really hate this place because of the music they play..... late at night..... when I'm trying to sleep.
Loved the vibe!   Staff was attentive and friendly.

Second time to go, first time getting food. Don't order the barbecue and I think you will be okay. Good service and atmosphere and other items I tried were fine, but the ribs were terrible, pulled pork and sausage were meh. I will go back, just won't order that anymore.
Nice whiskeys. Some very drunk clientele
Nice spot.  Good food.

Monday night live music was excellent, unfortunately the fried oysters were looking good, but mostly just bread lacking oyster. The first cocktail on the menu the classic old fashioned was served underboard and I ordered a beer and almost forgot that I ordered one because it took so long to receive it. Order the beer before the food but received it after. Hopefully they can fix these issues.

The bourbon selection is pretty fantastic at the whiskey jar and the staff were great. We stopped in on the way through town and had a few local brews and had some dinner. On a recommendation from the server, I got the BLT and it was unquestionably the best one I’ve ever had. The kids had grilled cheese and they were also raving about it. We had to wait about 25 minutes to get a seat outside, but that’s probably because we showed up around 6pm on a Friday night. I’ll definitely stop here the next time I’m in Charlottesville.
Good experience with attentive staff and decent food - nothing to write home about. The Wilson sandwich was tasty and the  house salad was good (w/ shrimp). The drink were a bit strong for my taste.
Nice place to chill with friends n family
Absolutely stunning stop in the Historic Downtown Mall showcasing local cuisine and delicious cocktails. I can’t ever go to Charlottesville without stopping!
Fun place and loads of ambiance!!
The ambiance is solid but the drinks are somewhat poor.

Fantastic beer, bourbon and whiskey list.
Locally sourced farm to table menu.
Pam, the bartender....very attentive service. You should definitely stop there when you're in the neighborhood. We just happened to be at UVA and needed a treat after.
Good food, good beer, great atmosphere… and a kick ass band tonight!
Shrimp and grits were great.  The "Wilson" chicken sandwich had just enough spice to notice.  Very good service.
When you close your restaurant for a private party on a Saturday put it on your website…

Planned a special trip with friends… got caught in a thunder storm walking to the restaurant… only to be told they are closed for a private party. This was not on their website or facebook page. When I mentioned to the person that they should post this to make other customer aware, he shrugged his shoulders and shut the door. First and last attempt to visit this place. 👎🏼
Absolutely delectable collard greens, fried chicken, fried oysters and more. Left fat and happy!
Live music, friendly atmosphere, whiskey sampling and delicious pub food. Their whiskey menu is extensive.

This place was amazing and the staff were super nice. Keep in mind it’s a casual dive bar vibe.
Was served super quick even though the place was packed.
Fun fact about the place is their live music. I was blown by the talent.
Highly recommend if you’re in town and want to vibe.
Manager called me back and fixed the billing situation.  I am very happy they responded to my google review.

I can highly recommend the Whiskey Jar Julep is made of very fresh ingredients  at the bar. The meat is not a poor quality cut but actual good quality and the sides are all good. Staff remembers faces despite the busy atmosphere. Drinks and food can be found cheaper but not for the exceptional quality of the well made food and drink.
Eddie with security was great!

We sat on the sidewalk and enjoyed the good times with everyone.  We shared a great feta salad and pork chop and broccoli  meals.  Plus a couple of good beers added to our experiences.  A great band playing an exceptional set of music made everyone at the bar and the downtown mall enjoy the evening.  ENJOY THIS PLACE!
Best variety of whiskey in cville

Our server this evening, Deja, went above and beyond to give us a great experience at the Whiskey Jar. She quickly helped us move out of the rain before we got really wet. She fixed a minor error when one meal was slightly different than expected. She was very busy but managed to give us cheerful attention when needed. The food and drink were excellent but it was her service that made it a evening to remember. Thank you.
Our "go-to" place for lunch when we are in Charlottesville.

Unfortunately, our visit to The Whiskey Jar was disappointing from start to finish. The service was inattentive — we had to ask the waitress twice and the hostess once just to get our visibly dirty table cleaned. The waitress never checked in on us after taking our order.

The food didn’t redeem the experience. The chicken was dry, and the collard greens lacked flavor. The country fried pork chop was underwhelming, with bland mashed potatoes and overly soft mac & cheese. I also witnessed the table next to us dealing with multiple drink order mistakes.

The outdoor dining area was unpleasant, made worse by a homeless man sleeping nearby — not the restaurant’s fault, but it added to an already uncomfortable atmosphere.

Check my other reviews — I’m generally very positive, but this experience fell far below expectations. I hope management takes feedback seriously and makes improvements. Do better.

Caveat Emptor: came for the celebrated fried oysters and whiskey sour, they were top notch, and our server Christopher B. fast and professional, but my credit card went missing (and was used at a local McDonald's the next day) after I accidentally left it in the check folder at our patio table out front. Bummer; reported to Cville police. Otherwise fast, pro service, plenty of leafy patio seating. A downtown gem, but do keep your wits about you!
Great food great vibe huge whiskey selection awesome staff would recommend all to give it a try !
Great space. Good whiskey. Superb staff because they know their whiskey, they are efficient, kind and friendly.
Great burger!

We hit happy hour and it was great. Really enjoyed the bourbon and vodka drink. Missed the music but look forward fo going back. Bartenders were great. Friendly and really knowledgeable about the big selection of bourbons/whiskeys.
Always a good place for a drink in downtown Charlottesville. We stopped by for one drink after dinner and ended up having two! They had a 2 man band from Waynesboro who played nicely.

I went with a friend for lunch. The decor was authentic and made the place charming.
I took the rack ribs with french fries and salad. The meat was really tender with a barbecue sauce. Absolutely loved it.
One of the top five Old Fashioneds I’ve ever had and some amazing fried oysters.

I reviewed this place 7 months ago and it hasn't changed after giving it another try recently.

This is the second visit in 7 days, and neither of them was mind-blowing. I had not planned on reviewing this spot since it is a local favorite. After the experience tonight I wanted to put my two cents in.

To begin, the drinks are great, as is the environment. There was a local group playing some music tonight, which I have heard before, and they are entertaining. No issues there. It was nice to see the folks dancing and having a good time. The drink selection is great too. I am writing this based on several visits and not a single visit.

The not-so-great. These last two times I have received glassware that was chipped and broken. Not a huge deal to some and I've been in food service before. I know first hand how this can become a big deal to some folks. I was honestly perturbed by the fact that it happened twice in a row. Sounds dumb, but I was not inspecting my glassware thoroughly when it was brought in; I did not notice that it was broken until I was already drinking from the glass. The first time I brought it up, the young man was very apologetic. This second time, the waiter (a different person) was sort of nonchalant and uncaring.

The food is mediocre and salty. I had a burger the first time that was made incorrectly. I notified the young man, who was apologetic but never came back with the condiments I requested. He didn't come back for a good 40 minutes, to be honest and I had decided to just eat my burger and go home by that time. This time I had the fried chicken. I won't make that mistake again hahaha. There was a breast and two other pieces which were unrecognizable because they were burnt and dried up. The breast was moist inside but the breading, potatoes, and gravy were all extremely salty.

I enjoyed my drink so I will just stay away from the food next time. Overall, my impression is that the location and live music is what makes the place great. definitely not the food nor the service. I want to say it was a one-off, but through the 3 or 4 past experiences, the service was never more than "ok".

Well, we tried. Heard about this place since we moved here and finally made the time to drive over and give it a try. That mistake won’t happen again. Horrible experience from start to walking out. We walked in and got sat right away as we missed the dinner rush by a little time, the waiter finally arrived at the table and we placed our order…never seen him again until about 30-45 minutes after we were sat. He comes up and says they had a new food runner and some miscommunication caused a delay and the food would be right out. Another 15-20 minutes later and still nothing. Wife goes to hostess station and asked for a manager and we were told there is no manager there and no one to talk to. Waiter meets her at station and then says that they are making our meal right now. We will not be returning when the service is that bad, also will tell everyone to avoid that place. If you are a member of the Bourbon Society or an avid enthusiast, I’d also recommend avoiding the place. The pours are heavily over priced from what I’ve seen around the country. #avoidatallcosts
Atmosphere was pretty cool, but the food and service was terrible. Also the drinks are mid

Disappointing experience at the Whiskey Jar. We arrived just before noon to no host at the front and staff hanging out by the bar. When we asked if they were open, the bartender replied dismissively and told us to seat ourselves. After a long wait, we were served a dish that was supposed to be a grilled whole trout—but it wasn’t grilled, wasn’t hot, and definitely wasn’t whole. Mediocre food and poor service.

The restaurant is so cute and the food is amazing! I absolutely love the cornbread and have to get it every time. I’m also a huge fan of the blackened catfish. This past time I got the oyster poboy with the broccoli salad and both of those were so good.

Got the bbq 3 meat platter. The ribs were dry and old, the pulled pork was cold and the smoked sausage was average at best. Honestly, the fries were the best thing in my plate. The bourbon/whiskey selection was really good though. The bbq needs some work.
Bar Manager could really teach his staff how to clean. Bar smells awful every time we go in there. No telling the last time this place got a deep clean. Would hate to see what the kitchen looks like.

I’ve been to The Whisky Jar restaurant twice now, and both times were absolutely amazing! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, the service is top-notch, and the food is consistently delicious. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.
Early afternoon drinks, great service, wonderful  drinks, tasty burgers, and delicious French fries!
greag place to have a drink and celebrate Saint Patrick's day
I've been here on and off in the last 10 years and they never disappoint with my Old Fashioned.
Love this place!   We eat here every time we're in Charlottesville.
A great little treat.  Interesting live music, good beer, and great sandos.
Really good food and great selection of whiskey!

Ordered take-out via their online platform, which can be found on the home page of WJ’s website as a giant button saying ORDER ONLINE. Arrived at the stated time the receipt told me to get there, and the staff told me they had no idea what I was talking about, they had never heard of an online ordering system, and there was no order for me. The payment did bounce later, so I at least got a refund.
Great whiskey bar with an awesome southern flair to the food menu. Bourbon and whiskey selection is second to none with great pricing.
Nice citrusy/mule cocktail, mac&cheese/BBQ, and beer selection

Stopped in for drinks and late night appetizers.  Excellent boubon selection!  Cocktails were good enough to visit again.  The wings were decent and acceptable for bar food, but not great.  Cool spot overall.
Maggie was excellent!!  She was so attentive and kind. She told us in depth stories about the food. The food was AMAZING as was the SERVICE. Highly recommend!!
Ordered a campfire Old fashioned, the best i had this far!
The food was amazing!! Tiegan was our server and she was the best!! Seriously made our night so much better!! We will definitely be back on Tuesday to play Bingo! 😊
Amazing band with lots of horns! The food was delicious and the apple pie mule was really good and not too sweet
Vegan burger was delicious!  Wait staff extremely friendly and helpful.
It was a cute spot!
Great bourbon selection

I enjoyed the quality of food, service, and atmosphere on a Friday night but lost my class ring. Jimmy and two hostesses facilitated the return of my ring, which I found to be incredibly courteous and kind. Thank you all so very much! It means so much to me to have my ring back.

We used The Whiskey Jar for our Oct. 2024 wedding after party. Chris and the team were extremely welcome and let us use the whole space for our guests, play music and use the space as we needed. Would highly recommend for this type of event, since there are few late-night options in town.
I absolutely love the atmosphere we arrived during a very busy time and waited 15 mins for a table and received excellent service!

I was looking for an authentic southern restaurant to take my friend to. This place did not disappoint. very solid a pulled pork. Barbecue nachos was loaded and tasty. The brussels sprout was so good. Everything was seasoned well and not overwhelming. We also try their signature cocktail with whiskey and really like it a cute little place in downtown to recommend.

The food is overpriced and under portioned. Genuinely some of the worst food I’ve ever had in Charlottesville. The fries are worse than McDonald’s quality and the menu looks like it was designed by someone who has never been to a restaurant before. It’s dirty inside, the layout is strange. Don’t bring your family here if you’re expecting to get your moneys worth or even the minimum standards.
Great drinks and service at Whiskey Jar. Quality bands play here and cocktails are printed reasonably.
Great food, drinks, and vibe. Probably the best comfort food you can get in Charlottesville.

They get the 4th star due to the extensive whiskey library available. Impressive. The service, though very pleasant, was very slow, and the food, while served in decent proportions was uniformly extremely salty. Perhaps though, someone could let the hostess know that sticking her hands up under her shirt to adjust "things" is a bathroom activity, not something to do at the front station. Just sayin' 😳🤦
This place was really cool. The live music was good and the food was excellent.

Great dessert, okay dinner but there was more gravy than grits. Would not get shrimp n grits again. Was a solo diner and my server seemed to forget about me. He didn’t come by often so had to get a busser ask him for the check. Great vibe.

Whiskey flight, bbq mac n cheese, and country fried pork chops… sign me up!! Excellent dining experience all around. Service was exceptional and all the food offerings were delicious! Highly recommend if you’re in the area!!
Awesome find. Great service
Food's okay.  I had a burger and fries, nothing to write home about. Service is slow slow slow slow.
This place sucks
Love the ambiance of this place! They had a band playing that night and the vibes were just amazing! The food was definitely made with love. The best cornbread I've had in my life!

Maybe the best pulled pork sandwich I’ve ever had. Excellent pulled pork sandwich, fries and cole slaw with a delicious Virginia IPA 🍺 at The Whiskey Jar downtown Charlottesville. Brownie with ice cream was also great. My sever Jordon is a great guy. Today was his mom’s last day working there ‘cause she’s buying a dump truck. He wants a dump truck too. I said I hope he gets ten dump trucks. Thanks for making a great dinner part of my Charlottesville visit experience!
I come here for the live music and great drinks!

Excellent bar and restaurant. Food menu has everything you would like from a smoke house. We stay at the bar for an after dinner cocktail. Excellent service and good cocktails. We tried again the evening after but no luck on having a sit at the bar or restaurant…busy place and I know why. Strongly recommend. We’ll be back soon.
The food was well done and service was spot on. We enjoyed our lunch stop in Charlottesville on the way to Madison.

It's okay. Ordered the BBQ Nachos, the meat was warm, serving size would be for two. Small amount of nacho cheese.

Whole fish entree, was bone-in- i didn't mind. The cooked Brussel Sprouts were fine.

The pork platter was cold, we had to order a repeat of the dish. No uncharge.

Atmosphere was nice, downtown mall was great.

Service was good and drinks were fine :)
We had two whiskey drinks, a manhattan and a whiskey sour. Not so good, to be polite. But people were having a blast on a Saturday night. I can't give a review of food, beer etc.
Poorly done whiskey drinks...go elsewhere if you're looking for true craft cocktails.
Good selection of old fashioneds and the ribs were good.
Best bar on the mall, especially when Cougar Beatrice plays

The Whiskey Jar was a fun little place to grab a drink and get out of the rain. Great bourbon selection but good luck paying for it, we passed on almost any pour because of the prices. WLW was $200, Blanton's Gold was very expensive (can't remember exactly), EHT Single was $80.00 (across the plaza at the one wine  bar we were just at is $18.00, much better)... So we had a beer, great service, and left.

The whiskey selection is phenomenal. Prices are…average at best. I’ve had better prices on high end whiskey In Alexandria but I wouldn’t say this place is high. The smoked wings were absolutely outstanding. Some of the best I’ve ever had, truly. Bread pudding was also top notch. Service was ok. A little surly but again not at all bad. Live music and vibe overall were great.

Today, September 20, 2024 at 3 pm during happy hour, I asked if this whiskey was included in happy hour, to which they replied that it was not. I was disappointed after this bad experience.

The place is very cozy. I went to the supposed happy hour and asked for a supposed rail of whiskey and they only gave me one. Isn't it supposed to be like putting a small rotating table or board with several whiskeys?

I ordered chicken soup, has anyone ever tried it with too much salt? Well, they serve it here, but I wouldn't go back.

I just wanted to try a variety of their whiskeys and I left feeling sadder for not even knowing what I had tried.

Awesome food. The pork nachos were amazing. I love their collard greens. I generally like more pork in my collard greens (I'm a sucker for ham hocks) but I overlooked the little amount of pork in it due to how good the collard greens themselves were. The fried chicken was something else. Fried Oysters with Roumelade were the bomb. I wanted to eat the entire plate, but I didn't want to hog it all from my friends, haha. I also enjoyed the Thursday night music thing with Matthew O'Donnell.  A really dope folks singer. I definitely would like to hear his drop more. The servers were awesome and took good care of us.  I wish I knew the names. One of them was a nice blonde lady wearing a beautiful cross necklace and a young man with curly hair. Really super awesome folks.

The cozy whiskey snug atmosphere welcomes you from the cobblestone of the downtown mall district of Charlottesville. Busy patronage doesn’t preclude the personable service from a friendly and professional staff. The food is prompt and cooked to perfection, I had the 3 meat BBQ platter and wasn’t disappointed with any of the choices. The pork was nice and moist but not too Smokey and a hit of vinegar. Ribs were moist with a good bark and just enough sauce. The sausage was spicier than I thought and a crackling’ good, and went well with the Mac n’ cheese. The collards were Smokey and sweet.
Lindsay, the bartender extraordinaire, had nothing but the greatest suggestions and a courteous smile. The Virginia flight is well worth it with an exceptional rye, and the whiskey selection was tremendous and well chosen.
If you like whiskey this place is for you
Great place for some drinks and live music.
One of our favorite spots in C-ville! We've been going since it opened! My OG favorite dish was the sweet potato dumplings over the BEST creamed spinach!
Large whiskey selection. Younger wait staff do not have manners or social skills, older ones do. Shrimp and grits had shrimp that still had tails and unprocessed. Sauce was good though.

I had a dinner with my family and all was great
Top Ambiance with live concert
Food tasty and generous portions
And an amazing whiskey selection
Perfect !

Food was great, I got the trout.
Dessert was amazing, I got the bourbon bread pudding.
The facility was sub par. As a wheelchair user, the building was not accessible. No wheelchair access to the bathroom. This is 2024. ADA was established over 30 years ago. There is NO excuse for a public building to be ADA non-compliant.
The doorways are too narrow. The "ramps" are poorly made, and dangerous. There is a STEP between the dining area and the bar, where the bathroom is located.
Inexcusable!!!
The food here is so delicious, we were thinking about it for days after! One of the best restaurants we’ve had in a while!
Love the atmosphere and bartenders. Came on a Saturday night and there was an amazing Strokes cover band playing

We love to stop here on our way back home from visiting up north. Great place for a beer and food.  Service is very attentive. The live music never disappoints.  We stopped this past Tuesday and we were able to catch the Weedeaters String Band.  I really wish we lived a lot closer to Charlottesville.
Cool place, great eats and nice folks

Very charismatic live music, but the food was middle of the road. I started with a piña colada-esque cocktail with strawberries and it was quick good. The crunch burger was a solid option for dinner, but my one complaint was that the bottom bun was completely soaked by the time I received my plate. Fries were similar looking to McDonalds. The desert I selected was the bread pudding, which was served in a scolding pan, but somehow the center was still cold. Service was not great, but they were busy and trying to cater to a large quantity of tables, which I understand. Would advise others to go to Miller’s Downtown or 3 Notch’d Brewing over this one.
I love this place. If you’re a whiskey fan this is a go-to. I’ve tried so many new spirits and I’m never disappointed.
A great find! Their house made Apple Whiskey is amazing!
Quaint little place with a relaxed atmosphere.
Food here was decently priced for what you get. Burger was good. Large whiskey selection. Only slight disappointment was both my old fashions were served with regular ice and not a large ice cube.
Monday night 5 piece band was great, a lot of Whiskey choices and Beer as well.

First of all, the food was incredible. My burger was great! I had very high hopes about the old fashioned and mint julep but they were underwhelming. I feel Like the staff is overworked and they need more support.
Fried chicken was bland and dry, greens we tasty!

Whiskey Jar is one of the quintessential Cville experiences. You can get a $100+ pour of whiskey or a beer and a shot for less than $10. Immense selection of whiskey (bourbon and others), great cocktails, and good food. The live music can get loud, but the bands are always a fun time!
Tres bon, bien que rustique
Late open on the weekends. Fun but not too rowdy of a crowd.
